en: A multi‑view illustrated postcard with tinted photographs of a river valley and wooded landscape, showing villas and a mill complex by the water and forested cliffs. The images are framed by decorative oak leaves and twigs. Each small view has a German caption such as "Gastwirtschaft mit Garten," "Aus der Vogelschau," "Eingang," "Wappenfelsen," and "Überfahrt." At the bottom right, bold stylized text reads "LAUENHAINER MÜHLE bei MITTWEIDA." A red manuscript number "22252" appears at the top.
